controls.capDescription: The AUSD0 multisig controls the Initia LayerZero OFT representation's bridge mint/burn path and its package, peer/delegate, blocklist, pause/configuration, and rate-limit administration. Current route capacity is unresolved rather than treated as numerically capped because the rate-limit table is empty and peer/security configuration was not fully decoded.
controls.evidence: At Initia height 20754353, AUSD0 package object 0xf407bcfb373a0ff7f6ddc765a1e2f51056334afaf9bdeb8ecdebb877f0249be2 had ObjectCore.owner = 0x486bc26c1ed1c199ca550cf8953e00421b4ca2cb4ad9967f7dc8db384782a02d. That owner was the native AUSD0 Multisig - Weighted wallet with five weight-10 voting members, one weight-1 proposer, and threshold 30, an effective 3-of-5 quorum. OAppStore.admin and delegate both equal the multisig and its peer table length is 7. oft_fa::OftImpl exposes mint_ref and burn_ref with freeze_fungible_store_enabled=true; oft_impl_config reports an empty blocklist and empty rate_limit_by_eid table, with fee bps 0. All eight package modules are COMPATIBLE, and the public ABI exposes set_peer, remove_peer, set_delegate, set_config, send/receive library setters, set_enforced_options, set_blocklist, set_rate_limit, fee setters, and transfer_admin. Exact peer EID/address mapping, DVN/Executor/library configuration, and numeric caps remain unresolved; no protocol defaults are assumed. These bridge mint/burn and upgrade/admin facts are preserved here rather than compiled as native iUSD Mint Authority.
